numeric_check.check_note: BRCA1 BayesDel ≥0.28 calibration: printed LR 7.09 (95% CI 6.06–8.30); 377/456 functionally pathogenic, 149/1278 functionally benign. Exact Table2 row inspected in freshly fetched primary PMC HTML. Functional-reference calibration, not independent complete clinical classification. Historical article specifies v1.0; a new prospective evaluation must pin the then-current ClinGen specification.

missing_comparisons: Independent complete clinical classifications, serious-error adjudication and equal-evidence reviewer-time comparison were not found in selected evidence.
BayesDel labels derive from functional assays; threshold calibration is not held-out pathogenicity validation.
Study v1.0 manual pilot revises specifications on the same variants; current specification version must be pinned for any new run.
